title.zh: 链上授权、付款与课程入账可靠性
title.en: Reliable on-chain approval, payment, and course reconciliation

purpose.zh: 将代币授权与付款拆成独立钱包操作，并以精确交易哈希可靠核对 SmartLingo 课程权益。
purpose.en: Separate token approvals from payment and reconcile SmartLingo course access against the exact transaction hash.

zh: 每次点击只发起一笔授权或付款交易，授权确认后等待链上额度同步。
保留站内余额、合约模拟与费用预检，由钱包在确认页计算最终 Gas limit。
服务端用交易哈希、TransactionID、收款身份和代币规则共同验证付款。
en: Submit only one approval or payment transaction per click and wait for allowance propagation after confirmation.
Keep balance, contract simulation, and fee preflight while letting the wallet calculate the final gas limit.
Verify payment server-side against the transaction hash, TransactionID, recipient identity, and token rule.

zh: SmartLingo 课程加密付款与权益入账
en: SmartLingo course crypto checkout and entitlement reconciliation

zh: 增加钱包账户一致性检查、重复授权防护和钱包错误状态提示。
Polygon 公共 RPC 增加独立供应商容错，避免单一节点异常阻塞权益核对。
保留 SmartLingo 独立课程、定价、合约与支付数据，不复制其他站点配置。
en: Add active-account validation, duplicate-approval protection, and actionable wallet error states.
Add independent Polygon public RPC failover so one provider cannot strand entitlement reconciliation.
Preserve SmartLingo-specific courses, prices, contracts, and payment data without copying configuration from another site.

zh: 运行支付契约测试、完整自动测试、零警告 lint、生产构建和共享站点门禁。
未执行真实付款，也未启动实时音视频测试。
en: Run payment contract tests, the full automated suite, zero-warning lint, production build, and shared site gates.
No real payment was made and no realtime audio/video test was started.

zh: 真实钱包签名与链上付款由站点所有者按需执行。
en: Live wallet signing and on-chain payment remain owner-operated when needed.

zh: 适配 SmartLingo 按语言和课程授予三个月访问权的现有业务模型。
en: Adapted to the existing SmartLingo language- and course-scoped three-month access model.

rollback.zh: 回退至上一成功的 Cloudflare 部署；不涉及数据迁移。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare deployment; no data migration is involved.
